# configuration file /etc/apache2/httpd.conf:
ServerRoot "/etc/apache2"
Listen 80
Listen 8443 https
Include conf.d/*.conf

# configuration file /etc/apache2/conf.d/00-tls-default.conf:
<IfModule mod_ssl.c>
    SSLCertificateFile ssl/default.crt
    SSLCertificateKeyFile ssl/default.key
    SSLCertificateChainFile ssl/default.chain.pem
</IfModule>

# configuration file /etc/apache2/conf.d/10-www.conf:
<VirtualHost *:8443>
    ServerName www.example.com
    SSLEngine on
</VirtualHost>
